title: Re-enactment the Hartland Board of Trade seeking a bridge
description: On Sunday, May 13, 2001, large crowds gathered to witness a re-enactment of the historic medical emergency crossing from May 13, 1901. The event featured a horse-drawn carriage, owned by Judy and Dale Manual, carrying present-day Hartland doctors Ghanem and Stocek and their three sons: Noah, Matthew, and Alex.
